findings.message: An exact-digest artifact of any kind can occupy any named baseline slot; the guard must enforce each slot's canonical kind and intrinsic artifact identity where the baseline contract exposes one.
The target artifact is accepted from revision/treeDigest shape alone without requiring canonical RepositorySnapshot apiVersion/kind.
A 40-character target commit and 64-character source commit are individually valid but cannot describe one repository object format; the plan must require equal commit lengths.

requiredCorrections: For each baseline slot require its canonical kind: RequirementsBaseline, ProjectOverviewBaseline, ArchitectureBaseline, ContractDisposition, WorkBreakdownBaseline, WorkDependencyBaseline, and SpecialistAssignmentBaseline.
Where the baseline artifact exposes artifactId, dispositionId, or baselineId, require reference.artifactId to equal that intrinsic identity as well as binding its exact canonical bytes.
Require target.artifact apiVersion devrelay.dev/v1alpha1, kind RepositorySnapshot, a non-empty repository identity, canonical revision/treeDigest, and exact byte/reference binding.
Require sourceCommit and expectedTargetCommit to use the same Git object-id length; add a cross-format negative fixture.
Add wrong-kind, swapped-slot, intrinsic-ID substitution, non-RepositorySnapshot, and mixed-hash-format negative tests while retaining all prior attempt-003 coverage.
